_comment: Copy to tools/notes-source.json and fill in. Keys are player ids from
data/players.json; values are the 2-3 sentence summary shown in the app.
Write these yourself or generate them — but note that paid sources such as
Dobber are licensed to you, not to everyone who can open the published
site, which is why the built notes.json is gitignored and imported on
device rather than shipped with the app.
connor-mcdavid: Still the engine of everything Edmonton does, and the safest bet on the board for raw point volume. Health is the only real question after a compressed season. Take him first overall without thinking about it.
quinn-hughes: Drives Vancouver's power play and eats the minutes that come with it, which is where his assist totals come from. The best pure points-from-the-back-end option in this pool.
